plan.major: Automotive Electronics Specialist A6, A7 & A8
plan.notes: Transcribed from the official College of Marin Career Education Catalog (cte.marin.edu, Academic Year 2022-2023), Electronics Technology program page. PROGRAM OFFERINGS lists 'Certificate of Achievement, Automotive Electronics Specialist A6, A7 & A8 (18 units)'. FALL CORE CLASSES sum to 8.0 (AUTO114A 4, AUTO228A 4) and SPRING CORE CLASSES sum to 10.0 (AUTO116A 6, AUTO244A 4); 8 + 10 = 18, matching the certificate total exactly. The 'ADDITIONAL ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY COURSES' (ELEC120, ELEC200, ELEC260, ELEC290A, ELEC292A) are listed separately as additional courses, not part of the 18-unit certificate, and are excluded. All classes at Indian Valley Campus; scheduling subject to change. (The same 18.0-unit certificate also appears among the Automotive Technology program offerings.)
